question: What bodily form results from constant yogic practice over sixteen years?
premises: Constant practice is joined with yoga
inference: Through constant yogic practice, one attains the form of a sixteen-year-old.
uncertainties: dvi-aṣṭa-varṣa-ākṛtiḥ is interpreted as the appearance of sixteen years.
plain_english: Through constant yogic practice, one attains the form of a sixteen-year-old.
